# The Grand — Royal Banquet & Lawns

> Wedding and event venue in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, featuring five event spaces across lawn and indoor banquet settings.

The Grand — Royal Banquet & Lawns is an event venue located on Raibareli Road in Bindaua, Lucknow. The property hosts weddings, receptions, corporate gatherings, and private celebrations across five outdoor lawns and indoor banquet spaces.

## Contact & Location

- Address: 22, Raibareli Rd, Bindaua, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226301, India
- Coordinates: 26.6355667, 80.9992764
- Phone: +91 91291 27091
- Email: Thegrandbanquet07@gmail.com
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/94Dr1K1iPbZ3kR117
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thegrand.lucknow/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thegrandlucknow/

## Event Venues

- [Open Earth Lawn](https://the-grand-lucknow.vercel.app/venues/open-earth-lawn): 25,000 sq ft outdoor lawn, capacity up to 2,500 guests.
- [Grassland Gala](https://the-grand-lucknow.vercel.app/venues/grassland-gala): 20,000 sq ft outdoor lawn, capacity up to 800 guests.
- [Garden Galaxy](https://the-grand-lucknow.vercel.app/venues/garden-galaxy): 15,000 sq ft outdoor lawn, capacity up to 300 guests.
- [The Grand Courtyard](https://the-grand-lucknow.vercel.app/venues/the-grand-courtyard): 15,000 sq ft courtyard venue, capacity up to 250 guests.
- [The Royal Legacy Banquet](https://the-grand-lucknow.vercel.app/venues/the-royal-legacy-banquet): 10,000 sq ft indoor banquet hall, capacity up to 600 guests.
